title: Binary Linear Decoder
text: Decode BCH code to recover binary vector data, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Primitive polynomial} sets Primitive polynomial ’X^4 + X +; {Codeword length, N}, {Message length, K}, {Shortened message length, S}, {Generator polynomial}, {Disable generator polynomial checking} sets the option to disable generator polynomial, {Puncture vector}, {Enable erasures input port} sets the option to enable erasures input port and {Output number of corrected errors} sets the option to enable port to output number of corrected. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Generator polynomial
params.values: Generator polynomial ’X^10 + X^8 + X^5 + X^4 + X^2 + X + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector | binary Galois row vector

params.name: Primitive polynomial
params.values: Primitive polynomial ’X^4 + X + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector

params.name: Disable generator polynomial checking
params.values: Option to disable generator polynomial checking on (default) | off

params.name: Enable erasures input port
params.values: Option to enable erasures input port off (default) | on

params.name: Output number of corrected errors
params.values: Option to enable port to output number of corrected errors off (default) | on
